bank_name: AETS Part One 听力理解题库
schema_note: 每套题(set)含若干听力材料组(group)；每组一段对话(dialogue, P=飞行员 C=管制员)和1-4道题(questions)；answer 为正确选项字母；audio_* 为配套音频的规划路径（生成后按此命名）。
exam_note: 问题念完后5秒作答，听力只播放一遍（think_time_sec=5）。

paper_rules.说明: 组卷规则：不是150题混抽15题，而是分层随机。
paper_rules.q1_5: 从全部套卷的 slot=q1_5 组中（每套5组，共50组短对话，每组1题）完全随机抽5组，依次作为新卷 Q1-Q5。
paper_rules.q6_8: 从 slot=q6_8 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q6-Q8，不可拆分；可与其他组来自不同套卷。
paper_rules.q9_12: 从 slot=q9_12 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+4题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q9-Q12，不可拆分。
paper_rules.q13_15: 从 slot=q13_15 的组中（共10组，每组含1段对话+3题）随机抽1组，整组作为 Q13-Q15，不可拆分。

sets.title: AETS test simulation 8
sets.directions: In this part, you are going to hear a dialogue or exchange, after the exchange, there will be a question. After each question, you have 5 seconds to think and choose the correct answer. You will hear each question only once.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Apron, DLH550, a catering truck has hit our aircraft, we need an inspection before departure.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: DLH550, Apron, roger, maintenance is on the way, do not start up.

questions.question: What happened to DLH550?

options.D: It was hit by a catering truck.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "a catering truck has hit our aircraft"，即 DLH550 被餐车撞击，需要出发前检查，故选 D。APU 火警、雷击、爆胎在对话中均未提及。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CES6410, Wuhan Ground, taxi via B and B3, hold short of RWY05L, I say again, hold short of RWY05L.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Hold short of RWY05L, CES6410.

questions.question: What must CES6410 do?
questions.explanation: 管制员指令 "hold short of RWY05L" 并重复强调，即必须在 05L 跑道外等待、不得进入跑道，故选 A。B（立即穿越跑道）与指令相反。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Wuhan Control, CSN3907, a passenger has gone into labour, request priority landing and medical assistance on arrival.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3907, Wuhan Control, roger PANPAN, expect no delay.

questions.question: Why is CSN3907 making an urgency call?

options.B: Because a passenger was injured by turbulence.
options.C: Because a passenger had a heart attack.
options.D: Because a passenger is giving birth.

questions.explanation: 飞行员发出 PANPAN 呼叫，说明 "a passenger has gone into labour"（一名乘客临盆分娩），请求优先落地和医疗援助，故选 D。A、B、C 所述情况对话中均未出现。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW553, Wuhan Control, follow TM-01A Arrival, descend to 2700m on QNH1011, Info D.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, TM-02A Arrival, descend to 2700m on QNH1011, Info D, BAW553.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: BAW553, negative, TM-01A Arrival.

questions.question: What did the controller correct in the readback?
questions.explanation: 管制员发布的是 "TM-01A Arrival"，飞行员误复诵为 "TM-02A Arrival"，管制员纠正 "negative, TM-01A Arrival"，即纠正的是进场程序，故选 C。高度、QNH、通播编号均复诵正确。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach, CCA1135, we have a TCAS traffic advisory, traffic at 11 o'clock, 7nm, 300m above us, converging, confirm.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CCA1135, it's a climbing business jet, maintain 5100m.

questions.question: Where is the business jet?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告的冲突飞机位置为 "traffic at 11 o'clock, 7nm, 300m above us, converging"，管制员确认是那架爬升的公务机，与 A 完全一致；B 把 above 错成 below，C 距离错，D 方位错。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN4520, ready.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN4520, cleared for takeoff, RWY18, surface wind 150 degrees 4m/s, after airborne, contact Departure on 121.1.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared for takeoff, Departure 121.1, CSN4520.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN4520, 250m climbing. We have a forward cargo door open indication, request hold at HZ to run the checklist.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN4520, roger, climb to 1500m, hold at HZ as published, report established in the hold.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Climb to 1500m, hold at HZ, wilco, CSN4520.

questions.question: What was the wind condition when CSN4520 took off?
questions.explanation: 起飞时管制员通报 "surface wind 150 degrees 4m/s"，风速仅 4 米/秒，属轻风，故选 C。既非阵风也非静风，且 150° 风对 18 跑道是顶风分量，B 错误。

questions.question: What problem does CSN4520 have?
questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "We have a forward cargo door open indication"，即前货舱门开启指示，故选 B。A、C、D 在对话中均未提及。

questions.question: What did the crew of CSN4520 request?

options.C: To hold and run the checklist.

questions.explanation: 机组请求 "hold at HZ to run the checklist"，即进入 HZ 等待以执行检查单，管制员也批准 "hold at HZ as published"，故选 C。未提放油、继续飞往目的地或立即着陆。

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR784, Wuhan Control, due traffic, offset 3nm left of track, expect rejoin the route at WHA.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Roger, offset 3nm left of track, AFR784.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Control, AFR784, we have a build-up ahead of us, request climb to 9800m to get over it.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR784, negative due traffic, can you accept deviation to the right for 10nm?

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Affirm, we need a heading of 130 for 20nm, AFR784.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR784, turn right heading 130, report clear of weather.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Right heading 130, wilco, AFR784.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Wuhan Control, AFR784, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence, two cabin crew members are injured, we are descending to 6000m.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: AFR784, Wuhan Control, roger MAYDAY, report reaching. Break Break. All stations, Wuhan Control, aircraft descending between WHA and ZF, all aircraft below 8400m, leave the route to the south.

questions.question: How did the pilot of AFR784 first plan to avoid the weather?
questions.explanation: 飞行员最初请求 "climb to 9800m to get over it"，即爬升越过前方积雨云，故选 A。向右偏置 10nm 是管制员随后提出的替代方案，并非飞行员最初的计划。

questions.question: Why was the climb not approved?
questions.explanation: 管制员拒绝爬升请求时说 "negative due traffic"，即因空中交通（冲突）未批准，故选 B。禁区、限制区、军方活动均未提及。

questions.question: What happened to AFR784?

options.B: It encountered severe turbulence and cabin crew were injured.

questions.explanation: 飞行员宣布 MAYDAY："encountered severe clear air turbulence, two cabin crew members are injured"，即遭遇严重晴空颠簸且两名乘务员受伤，故选 B。冰雹、雷击、发动机熄火均未提及。

questions.question: Where is AFR784 when it started descending?
questions.explanation: 管制员在 Break Break 通播中说明 "aircraft descending between WHA and ZF"，且 AFR784 宣布 "descending to 6000m"，即它在 WHA 与 ZF 之间下降前往 6000m，故选 B。8400m 是要求其他飞机避让的高度界限，A 错误。

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Wuhan Tower, CSN3201, 8nm final, established ILS, RWY36R.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3201, Wuhan Tower, continue approach, reduce speed to 150kts.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Continue approach, speed 150kts, CSN3201.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3201, Tower, cleared to land, RWY36R, wind 020, 10m/s, gusting up to 20m/s. QNH1002.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Cleared to land, RWY36R, QNH1002, CSN3201.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, CSN3201, we had a hard landing, we suspect structural damage, we have stopped on the runway. Unable to vacate, request a tug.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: CSN3201, roger, tug is on the way. Break Break. JAL663, go around, I say again, go around, runway occupied.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Going around, JAL663.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Tower, JAL663, request an approach to the opposite direction runway RWY18 to save time.

dialogue.speaker: C
dialogue.text: JAL663, negative, RWY18 is not available, expect approach RWY36R in 20 minutes, contact Wuhan Approach on 124.2.

dialogue.speaker: P
dialogue.text: Approach 124.2, JAL663.

questions.question: Why did CSN3201 stop on the runway?

options.D: A hard landing with possible structural damage.

questions.explanation: 飞行员报告 "we had a hard landing, we suspect structural damage, we have stopped on the runway"，即重着陆并怀疑结构损伤而停在跑道上，故选 D。刹车起火、爆胎、转向失效均未提及。

questions.question: What was the consequence of CSN3201's problem?

options.A: The aircraft skidded off the runway.
options.C: The aircraft was stuck on the runway and the runway was blocked.

questions.explanation: 飞行员称 "Unable to vacate, request a tug"，管制员随后指令 JAL663 "go around, runway occupied"，说明飞机被困在跑道上、跑道被占用，故选 C。飞机并未滑出跑道，也无起火或人员受伤信息。

questions.question: What did JAL663 request after the go-around?

options.A: To land on the opposite direction runway.

questions.explanation: 复飞后 JAL663 请求 "an approach to the opposite direction runway RWY18 to save time"，即改用反向跑道进近，故选 A。管制员拒绝该请求并要求联系进近，D 的 20 分钟等待是管制员的安排而非机组请求。
